articles.title: Government extends PLI scheme for textiles until 2033-34 to boost MSME participation and investments
articles.desc: The government has announced an extension of the Production Linked Incentive scheme for the textiles sector until 2034. This change aims to encourage more companies to participate by relaxing eligibility norms for investment. The textiles ministry has reduced the minimum turnover requirement for certain manufacturers from ₹200 crore to ₹100 crore. A reopened application portal will accept submissions for manufacturing various textiles from November 1 to December 31.

articles.title: Union cabinet approves 3% DA hike for 11.6 million central employees and pensioners, effective July 1
articles.desc: On Wednesday, the Union cabinet approved a 3% increase in dearness allowance for employees and pensioners. This increase is expected to benefit over 11.6 million individuals ahead of the festive season. The change will take effect retrospectively from July 1, costing the exchequer ₹10,016 crore. Additionally, the government revised dearness allowance rates for employees under the Fifth and Sixth Pay Commissions.

articles.desc: The Landscape of Green Finance in India, now in its fourth edition, maps actual finance flows or disbursements across sources, instruments, sectors, and subsectors for financial years 2022-23 and 2023-24. According to the report, while green finance has increased substantially between 2016-17 and 2023-24, financial flows remain concentrated in established sectors and technologies.

articles.title: Heat-related deaths up 36% since Paris Agreement: Lancet
articles.desc: The report, which was released on Wednesday, said the annual average heat-related deaths rose by nearly 36% globally after the Paris Agreement was introduced. "In 2023 alone, heat was linked to a record 710,000 deaths with more than 70% of that toll attributable to human-caused climate change," it said.

articles.title: New GST registration route allows online sellers to expand using ecommerce warehouses as local bases
articles.desc: Starting November 1, small online sellers will have a new option for GST registration. They can use ecommerce warehouses as local bases in other states, promoting nationwide sales. This initiative is part of a broader effort to simplify regulations and reduce expansion costs for small traders. Eligible sellers must meet specific conditions, including tax liability limits and operator consent.

The US Commerce Department later lifted the order.

articles.title: IIP growth eases to 4-month low in September as mining output contracts
articles.desc: September witnessed a decline in India's factory output growth, falling to 6.7%, the lowest rate observed in four months. The drop is largely linked to a high base effect and decreased mining activity. Despite this, manufacturing output surged by 7.6% compared to the previous year, while electricity generation also grew, spurred by robust demand even with insufficient rainfall. Economists anticipate GDP growth to surpass 7% for the July-September period.

articles.desc: The US Federal Reserve has decided to keep its benchmark interest rate unchanged to evaluate inflation trends. Policymakers are assessing how high inflation might affect future monetary policy amid the upcoming midterm elections. articles.title: German startup NVision shows new path to quantum computing chips in Nature paper
articles.desc: Startups and tech giants such as Microsoft and IBM alike are racing to build quantum computers that hold the promise of solving problems that would take conventional machines thousands of years. But NVision, which has raised more than $155 million in funding from firms such as Abbott Laboratories, made the discovery published on Wednesday while working in an entirely different field: improving medical devices.

articles.title: Karnataka, DGFT to host state-level workshop to help exporters leverage FTAs
articles.desc: On October 30, a workshop will be organized by the DGFT, Karnataka government, and FIEO in Bengaluru. The event aims to enhance Karnataka's export competitiveness and awareness of Free Trade Agreements. Nearly 200 participants, including exporters and industry officials, are expected to attend. Technical sessions will cover opportunities in various sectors and policy interventions under new FTAs. Senior officials and the state minister will address attendees at this important event.

articles.title: PM Modi to release Rs 18,680 crore under PM-Kisan scheme on October 30
articles.desc: On October 30, Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to launch the 24th installment of the PM-Kisan scheme in Gujarat, aiming to support over 9.34 crore farmer families across the country with more than Rs 18,680 crore. In Gujarat alone, financial assistance surpassing Rs 1,051 crore will be granted to over 52.33 lakh farmer families.

articles.desc: The comment comes as UK and Netherlands pledge extra military support for Kyiv.

articles.title: Satin Creditcare Q2 profit surges over three-fold as asset quality improves
articles.desc: Satin Creditcare Network reported a more than three-fold rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 176 crore in the second quarter, helped by lower microfinance provisions, portfolio growth and improved asset quality. Its gross NPA ratio improved to 1.9% from 3.5% a year earlier, signalling a recovery from earlier stress.

articles.desc: New UK war crimes complaint against an Israeli soldier highlights a global legal campaign to end systemic impunity.

articles.title: Cholamandalam Investment Q2 net profit rises 41% on strong income growth, plans Rs 5000 crore capital raise
articles.desc: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance reported a 41% rise in second-quarter net profit to Rs 1,630 crore, helped by strong income growth, higher loan disbursements and lower loan losses. The company’s board approved a proposal to raise up to Rs 5,000 crore through a qualified institutional placement.

articles.title: Hero MotoCorp Q2 profit jumps 41% as scooter and EV sales surge
articles.desc: Hero MotoCorp’s Q2 FY27 consolidated profit rose 41% to Rs 1,860.55 crore, while revenue increased 23% to Rs 14,970.50 crore. Scooter sales surged 47%, VIDA retail sales grew 76%, and international expansion strengthened growth prospects.

articles.title: British homebuilder shares slump on lack of clarity over first-time buyer plan in budget
articles.desc: Shares of British homebuilders plummeted following finance minister John Healey's budget speech about housing initiatives. The delays surrounding the launch and funding of the awaited 'Your First Home' scheme have analysts worried that it won’t receive long-term financial support. Prominent companies like Barratt Redrow, Taylor Wimpey, and Persimmon experienced sharp declines, which could further hinder the timeline for new site developments that builders are eager to pursue.

articles.title: Weak returns at home fuel India's overseas retail investing boom
articles.desc: Indian retail investors are increasingly venturing into global markets, significantly boosting their overseas investments. In response, domestic asset managers are introducing new funds to meet the rising demand for international exposure. With the Reserve Bank of India's limits on overseas investments nearing their cap, many investors are exploring tax-friendly locations like GIFT City.

articles.title: Hero MotoCorp Q2 Results: Profit surges 41% YoY to Rs 1,861 crore, revenue jumps 23%
articles.desc: Hero MotoCorp’s Q2 FY27 consolidated profit rose 41% to Rs 1,861 crore, while revenue increased 23% to Rs 14,971 crore. Scooter sales, 100cc motorcycles and VIDA electric scooters boosted growth, alongside international expansion and investments.

articles.title: India only major emerging economy set to reduce debt ratio by 2031: RBI Deputy Governor
articles.desc: India is projected to be the only emerging market economy among nine economies with gross domestic product (GDP) exceeding USD 1 trillion to reduce its government debt-to-GDP ratio between 2025 and 2031, Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta said, highlighting the country's stronger fiscal position amid rising global debt and borrowing costs.

articles.title: Union Cabinet approves Rs 7,395 crore for PM Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana
articles.desc: Union Cabinet has allocated Rs 7,395 crore for the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana. This scheme will promote local-level capacity building and resource management for panchayats across India. Elected representatives will receive training to enhance their governance capabilities and local planning efforts. The initiative aims to financially empower panchayats through better utilization of available resources. Implementation will occur from 2026-27 to 2030-31, aligning with the Sixteenth Finance Commission period.

articles.title: Sebi to review FPI compliance norms, issue consultation paper to align with global standards
articles.desc: Sebi Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated they will review compliance requirements for foreign portfolio investors in India. A consultation paper will seek feedback on aligning these norms with global standards while ensuring investor protection. This initiative aims to enhance foreign investor participation in domestic markets and streamline access procedures. Additionally, Pandey emphasized the significance of domestic savings along with international capital to support market development.

articles.title: Acutaas Chemicals among 5 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rallied up to 18% in a month
articles.desc: Despite the Sensex falling 352 points to 73,246, five BSE 500 stocks touched fresh 52-week highs on Wednesday. PVR Inox, Acutaas Chemicals, Indian Hotels, Piramal Pharma and Sona BLW posted monthly gains of 9% to 18%.

articles.title: Vedanta Aluminium Q2 Results: Profit doubles to Rs 6,187 crore, revenue jumps 41%
articles.desc: Vedanta Aluminium’s Q2 FY27 net profit surged 105% to Rs 6,187 crore, driven by record production, higher sales and improved realisations. Revenue rose 41%, EBITDA increased 83%, and net debt declined Rs 3,090 crore sequentially.

articles.title: US stocks today: US stocks turn choppy as megacaps offset chip gains before Fed meet
articles.desc: In the US stock market, a mixed performance emerged as chipmakers like Micron Technology surged, buoyed by favorable reports from SK Hynix, while major tech players such as Tesla and Apple faced declines. Investors eye the Federal Reserve's imminent interest rate decision and important earnings announcements from Microsoft and Alphabet. The Nasdaq showed positive momentum this week, rising around 2%, reflecting growing optimism surrounding artificial intelligence.

articles.desc: SEBI and the Bank of England signed an MoU to strengthen regulatory cooperation and information sharing on clearing corporations. The framework supports cross-border supervision, enables reliance on SEBI’s oversight, and reinforces financial stability.

articles.desc: The chancellor begins his speech by calling it a Budget for the "working people of Britain, for British businesses big and small."

articles.desc: Driving approximately 36% of value verified to date, customers are leveraging AI and automated workflows to prevent costly asset shutdowns across complex industrial operations, help them get back running when the unexpected happens, and lower the costs of running their operations.

articles.title: Meesho expects stronger Q3 growth due to change in festive sale timeline
articles.desc: The first day of Meesho's annual flagship sale, the Mega Blockbuster Sale, saw orders growing about 75% YoY. Its transacting customers increased by about 60% YoY.

articles.title: Sherpa and the future of AI-powered storytelling at Pocket FM
articles.desc: Pocket FM is using AI to help writers bring their stories to life and reach listeners across the world. With Sherpa, its AI-powered writing partner, the company is making it easier to manage long storylines and develop characters while keeping the creative decisions in the hands of writers.

articles.title: India bonds end flat as oil woes come up against short covering
articles.desc: Indian government bonds faced volatility as oil price hikes raised inflation concerns and affected market sentiment. The 6.94% 2036 bond yield fluctuated but ended slightly unchanged as traders reacted to market conditions. Elevated crude prices have increased worries about inflation, a wider fiscal deficit, and slower economic growth for India. The rupee weakened further against the dollar, prompting fears of aggressive policy tightening by the Reserve Bank of India.

articles.title: Bandhan Bank Q2 profit jumps 5.6 times as asset quality improves
articles.desc: Bandhan Bank reported a five-fold rise in Q2 profit to Rs 622 crore, supported by lower provisions and improving asset quality. Net interest income grew 14%, margins strengthened, gross advances increased 13%, and deposits rose 9% year-on-year.

articles.title: Meesho Q2 Results: Loss narrows to Rs 132 crore YoY, revenue rises 34%
articles.desc: Meesho’s Q2 FY27 net loss narrowed 67.8% to Rs 132.45 crore, while revenue surged 34.4% to Rs 4,131.58 crore. Rising user engagement, stronger merchandise value, improved contribution margins and festive-season demand supported growth amid elevated spending.

articles.title: Tuborg maker Carlsberg India moves closer to IPO, files updated DRHP for complete OFS issue
articles.desc: Carlsberg India has filed an updated draft prospectus with Sebi for an IPO comprising 8.64 crore shares, entirely through an offer for sale by existing shareholders. The Tuborg maker could raise up to $700 million, according to earlier reports, as multinational companies increasingly tap India’s equity markets to monetise local businesses.

articles.title: India, Mexico begin talks for trade pact; aim to boost commerce, investments
articles.desc: India and Mexico have initiated negotiations for a preferential trade agreement to enhance bilateral trade and investment. The agreement aims to create new economic opportunities while addressing market access, customs procedures, and trade facilitation. Discussions included organising a Mexican business mission to India in early 2027 to improve commercial ties. India had a trade surplus with Mexico, largely due to exports in autos and pharmaceuticals.

articles.title: Hyundai Motor India Q2 profit falls 24% despite record sales
articles.desc: Hyundai Motor India’s Q2 FY27 net profit fell 24% to Rs 1,196.2 crore as commodity costs pressured margins. Revenue rose 19% to Rs 20,696.1 crore, supported by record sales, stronger exports and upcoming vehicle launches.

articles.title: Israeli stocks fall, shekel weakens as Netanyahu bloc beats election forecasts
articles.desc: Israel's election results indicate Prime Minister Netanyahu's right-wing bloc is projected to win 54 seats. While the opposition bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot is expected to secure 47 seats, neither group achieved a parliamentary majority. The shekel weakened significantly, and the Tel Aviv stock index fell following the surprising election results. Analysts predict a challenging path ahead for forming a stable government in Israel.

articles.title: Anant Raj Q2 Results: Profit rises 13% to Rs 156 crore
articles.desc: Anant Raj Ltd has demonstrated robust financial performance, with a 13 percent rise in consolidated net profits for the September quarter. The company's total income surged to Rs 678.95 crore, up from Rs 640.89 crore the previous year. For the first half of the year, net profit climbed to Rs 305.68 crore, compared to Rs 264.08 crore, signaling its strong standing in the Indian real estate sector.

articles.title: FED Meeting Live | Dow Jones Futures | US Stock Market Highlights: US stocks end higher after turning choppy on Fed's rate decision
Vedanta Aluminium quarterly profit more than doubles on high prices, record production
articles.desc: Vedanta Aluminium reported a significant increase in its quarterly profit, which more than doubled from the previous year. The company's consolidated net profit rose to 51.67 billion rupees for the quarter ending September 30. Revenue from operations also increased by 40% during the same period, driven by elevated aluminium prices. Aluminium production hit a record of 649,000 metric tons, up 5% from last year.

articles.title: Cholamandalam Investment Q2 Results: Profit surges 41% to Rs 1,630 crore; co plans to raise Rs 5,00O crore via QIP
articles.desc: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company has reported an impressive 41 percent surge in net profit for the second quarter, marking Rs 1,630 crore, up from Rs 1,155 crore the previous year. Their total income significantly increased to Rs 9,367 crore, primarily fueled by rising interest income. Additionally, the company's gross non-performing assets improved to 3.29 percent, signaling enhanced asset quality.

articles.title: TVS Motor Q2 Results: Profit jumps 52% YoY to Rs 1,377 crore; revenue rises 44%
articles.desc: TVS Motor Company reported a 52% rise in Q2 FY27 profit to Rs 1,377 crore, with revenue up 44%. Record sales, electric two-wheeler growth and strategic acquisitions boosted performance, while shares gained 2.52% on the NSE.

articles.title: Jio debuts on D-Street: India’s biggest IPOs delivered negative returns over one month after listing. Will Jio break the curse?
articles.desc: Jio Platforms has marked a significant milestone by successfully launching its market debut following India’s largest initial public offering, valued at Rs 30,213-crore. While historical trends indicate that stocks often experience negative returns post-major IPOs, initial reports present an optimistic outlook for Jio, with projections suggesting potential for growth as the company aims to expand its technological footprint through cutting-edge innovations across diverse sectors.

articles.title: From 104 shareholders to nearly 80 lakh! Jio becomes India's most widely owned stock on listing day
articles.desc: Jio Platforms has become India’s most widely held listed stock, with 79.6 lakh shareholders following its blockbuster IPO, overtaking Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, Reliance Industries and Vodafone Idea. From just 104 shareholders before the issue, Jio attracted over 1.38 crore applications and debuted at a market capitalisation of Rs 12.53 lakh crore.

articles.title: Centre open to changes in DPDP law to  protect press freedom, says Ashwini Vaishnaw
articles.desc: The Centre aims to amend the Digital Personal Data Protection law to address concerns raised by news publishers. Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that the law does not limit press freedom. This response follows a Supreme Court notice regarding a petition from the Digital News Publishers Association and others. Publishers argue the lack of exemption for journalism could jeopardize investigative reporting and confidential sources.

articles.title: MFs raise stake for 3 straight quarters in 5 mid-cap stocks; shares gain up to 75% YTD
articles.desc: Mutual funds steadily increased their holdings in 39 BSE midcap stocks for three consecutive quarters through September 2026. While five stocks gained 15–75% in CY26, several others declined sharply despite continued institutional buying.

articles.title: India's industrial growth slows to 6.7% in September from 8% in August
articles.desc: India's Index of Industrial Production for September recorded a growth rate of 6.7%. This figure represents a decline from August's 8%. Key contributors to this growth include the manufacture of motor vehicles and electrical equipment, among others. The manufacture of rubber and plastics also played a significant role in September's performance. These statistics were released by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.

articles.title: Info Edge Q2 Results: Net profit plunges 93% YoY to Rs 334 crore, revenue rises 13%; co declares Rs 3/share interim dividend
articles.desc: Info Edge reported a sharp year-on-year decline in Q2 net profit due to a large exceptional gain in the previous year, while revenue and operating profit grew. Recruitment, 99acres and matchmaking businesses recorded healthy growth, alongside AI-led expansion.

articles.title: Global Market: Nomura Holdings Q2 profit rises 13% on wealth management growth
articles.desc: Nomura Holdings reported a 13% YoY rise in second-quarter net profit to 103.7 billion yen, supported by strong wholesale earnings and steady wealth management growth. Its wholesale income jumped 47% amid robust trading and investment banking activity.

articles.title: Global Market: European shares waver as earnings, rising oil weigh on sentiment
articles.desc: European shares edged lower as investors assessed mixed bank earnings and rising oil prices ahead of the European Central Bank’s policy decision. Technology and energy stocks gained, offering some support amid broader market weakness.

articles.title: Elevated oil prices keep up heat on rupee, traders await cues from Fed
articles.desc: The Indian rupee closed lower against the dollar as oil prices surged due to supply concerns. Brent oil rose to $115.3 per barrel following recent events in Saudi Arabia. Iranian mediators proposed a new draft to resolve ongoing conflicts, with expectations for Tehran's response by week's end. Traders remain increasingly bearish on the rupee amid uncertainty in oil markets and economic implications.

articles.desc: DA hike: The Union Cabinet has approved several development schemes totaling Rs 29,267 crores for various initiatives. Among these is a Rs 10,016 crore increase in Dearness Allowance for Central government employees. The DA will benefit about 48 lakh employees and 68 lakh pensioners, with hikes effective from July 1, 2026.

articles.title: Diwali 2026: Sensex plunged 10,000 points, Nifty dropped 12% since last Diwali. Will Samvat 2083 bring some relief?
articles.desc: Dalal Street heads into Samvat 2083 after a turbulent year that saw the Sensex plunge over 10,750 points and the Nifty shed nearly 12% since last Diwali. The Iran-US conflict, elevated crude oil prices, persistent FII outflows and AI-led IT selloff weighed on sentiment. Can easing headwinds revive the market?

articles.title: Hyundai Motor India Q2 Results: Standalone profit falls 24% YoY to Rs 1,189 crore, but revenue rises 18%
articles.desc: Hyundai Motors India has reported a standalone net profit of Rs 1,189 crore for Q2 FY27, reflecting a notable decrease of 24% compared to Rs 1,570 crore during the same period last year. However, their operational revenue has grown to Rs 20,191 crore, representing an 18% increase from Rs 17,061 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous fiscal year. This performance illustrates the company's resilience amidst shifting market conditions.

articles.title: From Dhirubhai Ambani’s Rs 10 crore IPO to Akash Ambani’s Rs 12.5 lakh crore Jio debut: Reliance’s biggest wealth story
articles.desc: Jio Platforms’ Rs 12.5 lakh crore debut marks a new milestone in the Ambani family’s wealth creation journey, tracing Reliance’s evolution from its Rs 10 crore IPO in 1977 to a digital technology giant.

articles.title: Vedanta Q2 Results: Profit zooms 78% YoY to Rs 6,202 crore; revenue surges 57%
articles.desc: Vedanta Q2 Results: Vedanta Ltd reported a 78% year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 6,202 crore in the September quarter, while revenue increased 57% to Rs 26,356 crore. EBITDA more than doubled to Rs 9,938 crore, with margins improving to 60%. Higher commodity prices and increased production supported earnings, while net debt fell by Rs 4,624 crore to Rs 3,675 crore during the quarter.

articles.title: Ambani bluechip bet gets bigger: Investors mark 82% of traded Jio shares for holding beyond listing
articles.desc: Jio Platforms saw nearly 82% of its traded volume marked for delivery on debut, with 10.66 crore shares carried into settlement out of 13.02 crore shares traded. The stock listed at a 21.36% premium to its IPO price, while Nomura, Motilal Oswal and Elara Securities initiated coverage with Buy ratings.

articles.title: Adani Enterprises Q2 Results: Revenue spikes 75% YoY to Rs 37,216 crore,  profit at Rs 1,492 crore
articles.desc: Adani Enterprises Q2 Results 2026: Adani Enterprises has reported a 55% drop in consolidated net profit for the second quarter of FY27, with figures reaching Rs 1,492 crore compared to Rs 3,304 crore from the previous year. Conversely, operational revenue surged by 75%, hitting Rs 37,216 crore. This stark contrast is notable due to the previous year's inflated profits, driven by exceptional gains totaling Rs 3,583 crore, highlighting a dramatic shift in financial performance.

articles.title: Jio effect! Reliance beats Tata to become India's most valued conglomerate
articles.desc: Jio Platforms’ listing has propelled the Reliance Group to become India’s most valuable conglomerate, with a combined market capitalisation of over Rs 28 lakh crore, surpassing the Tata Group. Jio debuted at Rs 1,358, a 21% premium to its IPO price of Rs 1,119, adding over Rs 12.5 lakh crore to Reliance Group’s market value.

articles.title: Delivery Hero raises full-year forecast again on strong Q3 growth
articles.desc: The company now expects gross merchandise value (GMV), a common metric for delivery firms measuring the total value of all goods sold through the market place, to grow 10%-12% this year, up from a previous forecast of 9%-11%.

articles.title: China's new export curbs draw a line around its AI crown jewels
articles.desc: The draft rules, released on October 16, distinguish between foreign customers using Chinese AI services and foreign companies obtaining the models, data or expertise needed to operate or reproduce them independently.

articles.title: Agentic AI can cut banks' transaction monitoring workload by up to 50%: McKinsey
articles.desc: Banks could reduce the human effort required for transaction monitoring investigations by 30-50% by deploying agentic artificial intelligence (AI), while improving the quality and consistency of compliance reports, according to a report by McKinsey.

articles.title: Hyundai Motor Q2 Results Live Updates: Standalone profit at Rs 1189 cr vs Rs 1570 cr, down 24% YoY
Global Market: UBS Q3 profit rises 8% to $2.69 billion, accelerates buyback plan
articles.desc: ETMutualFunds identifies Axis, SBI, Kotak and Nippon India small-cap funds using parameters such as rolling returns, consistency, downside risk, outperformance and asset size. These schemes offer strong long-term return potential but are suitable mainly for aggressive investors with a high risk appetite.

articles.title: US Market: AI boom could weaken dollar’s safe-haven appeal as foreign flows rise
articles.desc: The US dollar’s safe-haven status could face pressure if the AI investment boom unwinds, prompting foreign investors to pull back from American equities and corporate bonds. Weaker growth, lower interest rates and credit-market stress could amplify the risk.

articles.title: Adani Ports Q2 Results: Net profit jumps 17% YoY to Rs 3,622 crore; revenue up 24%
articles.desc: Adani Ports Q2 Results: Adani Ports reported a 17% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 3,622 crore, while revenue grew 24% to Rs 11,340 crore. The company raised its FY27 revenue and EBITDA guidance by Rs 1,000 crore each and increased its capex guidance by Rs 3,000 crore, citing strong first-half performance.

articles.title: Jio Platforms delivers biggest listing gain among India’s 5 largest IPOs, jumps 21% on debut
articles.desc: Jio Platforms shares listed at a 21.35% premium to the IPO price of Rs 1,119, delivering the biggest listing-day gain among India’s five largest IPOs by issue size. Brokerages Nomura, Motilal Oswal and Elara Capital initiated coverage with Buy ratings, citing tariff hikes, subscriber monetisation and digital services growth.

articles.title: US Market: Treasury yields face pressure despite expected Fed rate pause
articles.desc: US Treasury yields face continued pressure from persistent inflation, rising government borrowing and uncertainty over AI investments, despite a recent bond market recovery. Investors are watching the Federal Reserve’s policy decision and midterm elections for signals on the outlook.

articles.title: Adani Green’s debt maths: Why leverage may fall below 4x as capex cycle matures
articles.desc: Adani Green Energy Limited is looking forward to a decrease in leverage as its upcoming projects start functioning and yield cash flow. With a substantial ₹2.4 lakh crore earmarked for capital expenditures by FY30, the company aims to enhance its renewable energy capacity. As project loans are paid off, leverage is expected to dip below four times.

articles.title: AI chips worth $12.1 million seized at Malaysia airport, customs authority says
articles.desc: Malaysian customs said on Wednesday that it had seized about 49.5 million ringgit ($12.11 million) worth of advanced artificial intelligence chips this month, as

articles.title: India's soybean imports surge to record as domestic prices rally
articles.desc: India's soybean imports significantly increased to 1.1 million metric tons in 2025/26 compared to the previous year. Rising domestic prices prompted Indian mills to enhance their overseas purchases of soybeans. The majority of these imports originated from Niger, which became the largest exporter to India.

articles.title: China's CXMT to start advanced AI memory production despite poor yields
articles.desc: The decision highlights China's intense shortage of the AI memory chips, which are essential to a government-backed push to develop domestic alternatives to Nvidia's AI processors at scale amid US curbs on access to foreign-made technology.

articles.title: TPG pursues $5 billion acquisition of British data centre group Ark: FT
articles.desc: Global alternative asset manager TPG is in talks to buy British data centre group Ark from Elliott Investment Management at a valuation of about $5 billion, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter.

articles.title: GST clarification on foreign investor brokerage offers sentiment boost, analysts say
articles.desc: The Indian government has clarified that brokerage paid by overseas clients may qualify as an export service. This could help foreign investors avoid the 18% goods and services tax on brokerage fees. Analysts suggest this clarification is sentimentally positive amid significant foreign outflows from Indian stocks. There is ongoing speculation regarding potential cuts in capital gains tax ahead of the federal budget.

articles.title: Indian IT firms poised to benefit from enterprise AI adoption as infrastructure costs rise: Report
articles.desc: Indian information technology (IT) companies are well-positioned to benefit from the growing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) by enterprises, as rising infrastructure investments and funding requirements increase financial risks for companies building and operating AI computing capacity, according to a research report by Anand Rathi.

articles.title: India, Mexico sign terms of reference to kickstart trade pact negotiations
articles.desc: India and Mexico have signed the Terms of Reference to initiate negotiations on a Preferential Trade Agreement. This agreement aims to enhance bilateral trade and investment opportunities between the two countries. Key negotiating areas include market access, customs procedures, and trade facilitation measures. Both delegations discussed organizing a Mexican business mission to India in early 2027.

articles.title: AI chip giant SK hynix says quarterly operating profit soars 630%
articles.desc: South Korean chip giant SK hynix said Wednesday its third-quarter operating profit soared 632 percent on-year, largely driven by the artificial intelligence industry's explosive demand for its advanced memory chips. The memory chip giant said it had posted record revenue and operating profit for six straight quarters since the second quarter of last year.

articles.title: Oracle's Larry Ellison dismisses 'SaaS apocalypse' fears, says AI will make software better
articles.desc: Speaking at Oracle AI World here, Ellison, the company's executive chairman and chief technology officer, rejected talk of a "SaaS apocalypse", in which businesses would use AI to build their own applications instead of buying software-as-a-service (SaaS) products.

articles.title: India among Oracle NetSuite's highest-priority markets, says Asia head Amit Suxena
articles.desc: Speaking to PTI on the sidelines of Oracle AI World, Amit Suxena, group vice president and head of Asia at Oracle NetSuite, an AI-native business management platform, said momentum among Indian businesses had been growing over the last four to five years.

articles.title: US agency approves Amazon Leo's $11.5 billion acquisition of Globalstar
articles.desc: The Federal Communications Commission said Tuesday it has approved Amazon Leo's $11.5 billion deal to acquire Globalstar as the retail giant's satellite arm aims to build a satellite-based communications network to take on Elon Musk's SpaceX Starlink unit.

articles.title: Nearly 60% of firms yet to move AI beyond pilots as deployment remains key challenge: Report
articles.desc: Nearly 60 per cent of organisations surveyed remain in the exploration or pilot stages of artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, with only around 40 per cent having moved to production or scaling, highlighting the challenge businesses face in deploying AI across their operations, according to a report by Citi Institute.

articles.title: Meta, Snap head to trial in another case about social media's harms
articles.desc: Jury selection is expected to begin on Wednesday in Los Angeles for another landmark trial about the alleged harms of social media on young users, with Meta and, for the first time, Snap as defendants. Meta and YouTube lost the first so-called bellwether case earlier this year, when a jury found them collectively liable for harming a young user known by the initials KGM, and ordered the tech companies to pay a combined $6 million penalty.

articles.title: India, Azerbaijan move to reset ties, boost energy investments and connectivity
articles.desc: Delhi and Baku are currently taking steps to improve bilateral relations through enhanced economic cooperation and connectivity initiatives. After a positive meeting, the Foreign Ministers of both nations emphasized the importance of the International North-South Transport Corridor. There has been a notable increase in Indian investment in Azerbaijan's energy sector, with cumulative investments reaching $1.26 billion. Additionally, both countries are working to strengthen security cooperation against transnational crime.

articles.title: Anthropic's record IPO faces some big questions
articles.desc: No startup has ever grown so fast. Investors have already grown nervous.

articles.title: OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips
articles.desc: OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips, The Information reported on Tuesday, citing a person familiar with the matter, as technology companies ramp up spending on data centers and semiconductors to meet surging demand for AI computing.

articles.title: US agency is again probing if Polymarket broke 2022 settlement, sources says
articles.desc: A US regulator is investigating whether prediction market operator Polymarket violated a 2022 enforcement deal in which it promised to ban US users from its main overseas platform, reviving an inquiry the agency shuttered last year without bringing

articles.title: India’s record bank cash surplus fades as RBI curbs rupee bets
articles.desc: Indian banks have seen their excess funds drop significantly as the Reserve Bank of India maintains liquidity tightness. This monetary policy is aimed at curbing speculation against the rupee, which has reached critical levels. The central bank has provided limited liquidity support and capped assistance at 1.5 trillion rupees. Consequently, overnight borrowing rates have risen close to the top of the monetary policy range.

articles.desc: Happy Wednesday! Cognizant has held discussions to invest in homegrown AI startup Sarvam. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.
